profile.reading: This facility, at 22262 Cloud Plaza, Sterling, Virginia 20166, at the southwest corner of Waxpool Road and Route 28 in Loudoun County's Data Center Alley, is a 238,000 square foot, 46 megawatt critical power data center that GI Partners acquired a majority stake in on May 19, 2022, per industry publication Dgtl Infra, paying 709 million dollars, or roughly 15.4 million dollars per megawatt, through an entity called GI TC Loudoun LLC. The seller, Sentinel Data Centers, specifically an entity called Sentinel Ashburn II LLC owned by Rabina Properties, retained a minority stake in the property after the sale. The building was delivered and fully commissioned by 2019 and sits on 23.8 acres of land adjacent to Vantage Data Centers' Ashburn campus, tracked elsewhere in this registry. Dgtl Infra describes the facility's tenant as a global technology firm functioning as a credit tenant, meaning an investment grade rated company under a long-term lease, consistent with GI Partners' own broader description of this and related Ashburn area holdings as fully leased, credit tenant properties acquired as institutional real estate investments rather than operated as a directly marketed colocation brand. GI Partners, a private investment firm founded in 2001 and headquartered in San Francisco managing more than 40 billion dollars across private equity, real estate, and data infrastructure strategies, has made multiple such acquisitions in Northern Virginia's Data Center Alley, including a separate fully leased facility at 43915 Devin Shafron Drive in Ashburn acquired in April 2023, and has signed a major lease with DataBank, another operator already profiled in this registry, for a new Ashburn, Virginia data center. GI Partners' broader Tech and Science real estate portfolio spans 49 properties totaling 10.1 million square feet across 12 markets.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] GI Partners is a private investment firm founded in 2001 and headquartered in San Francisco, with additional offices in New York, Dallas, Chicago, Greenwich, Scottsdale, and London. The firm manages more than 40 billion dollars in capital across private equity, real estate, and data infrastructure investment strategies, and functions as an institutional acquirer and owner of data center real estate rather than as an operating brand that markets colocation directly to end customers. GI Partners has made multiple acquisitions in Northern Virginias Data Center Alley, including the Sentinel data center in Sterling, Virginia, purchased from Starwood Capital, and a fully leased facility at 43915 Devin Shafron Drive in Ashburn, acquired April 18, 2023, offering 9 megawatts of critical power with room to expand, 100 percent leased to two credit-worthy tenants within a 98-acre campus that has been institutionally maintained since its original 2010 construction. The firm has also signed a major lease with DataBank, another operator already profiled in this registry, for a new Ashburn, Virginia data center. GI Partners broader Tech and Science real estate portfolio spans 49 properties totaling 10.1 million square feet across 12 markets. Because GI Partners operates as an investor and landlord across multiple Northern Virginia properties rather than a single named facility, this registrys one Virginia facility record for the company is treated as representing this broader investment relationship rather than a single confirmed address. reading.body:
This facility's published specifications contain no IT load, power capacity, or infrastructure details beyond the address. Without disclosed megawatt figures, renewable certifications, or water specifications, it cannot be assessed for its role in AI scaling against the electrical and cooling constraints that bind large training operations.

Virginia has published power capacity figures for only 23 of its 326 mapped data center facilities, totaling 1,375 megawatts across the state. This campus does not appear in that subset of published specs, placing it outside the measurable capacity inventory despite geographic presence in a major data center region.

GI Partners holds multiple Northern Virginia properties as an institutional landlord rather than operating a single named facility. The research note indicates prior acquisition of a 9-megawatt facility in Ashburn and involvement in other regional leases, but no operator-level published specifications for this Sterling location are available. Verification of which properties hold what capacity, or whether this address represents a distinct facility or a reference point within a broader portfolio, requires disclosure the operator has not made.
